description: Register a SageIntacctResource wrapping Sage Intacct's legacy XML Web Services gateway (xmlgw.phtml) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

sender_id.label: Sender ID
sender_id.description: Web Services sender ID registered with Sage support and whitelisted on the company

sender_password_env_var.label: Sender Password Env Var
sender_password_env_var.description: Env var holding the Web Services sender password

user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: Intacct user ID (an API-enabled web services user)

user_password_env_var.label: User Password Env Var
user_password_env_var.description: Env var holding the Intacct user (login) password

entity_id.label: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity/location ID for multi-entity companies (omit for single-entity companies)

name: Sage Intacct Resource
